title: Gardena Grödnerhof vs Miramonti: Which to Book? (2026) | Suites With Keith
description: Gardena Grödnerhof vs Miramonti, compared by a travel advisor who stayed at Gardena Grödnerhof and toured Miramonti in October 2026: location, rooms, pools and spa, hiking, families, and who each one suits.

hero.alt: The outdoor pool at Gardena Grödnerhof, looking over the rooftops of Ortisei
Looking down on Merano and the valley through the glass at Miramonti

sub: Two hotels about an hour apart, built for different trips. One is the best base in the Dolomites, right in Ortisei; the other is a quirky design hotel above Merano with the best outdoor pool I saw. Here is how I would choose.
stamp: Stayed at Gardena Grödnerhof · Toured Miramonti · October 2026

band.h2: Do you want the best base, or a stop with character?
paras: Gardena Grödnerhof was a close second to Forestis for me. It sits right in Ortisei, a genuinely charming town with great restaurants, with lifts to two completely different hiking areas, an incredible spa and warm, polished service. It is the most well-rounded hotel I saw in the region.

Miramonti is a nice, unique property with an iconic pool, close to Merano. It isn’t at the level of the region’s top hotels as a luxury experience, but it is a great hotel for someone who values personality, the pool and the views over polish.

If you are coming to hike, eat out and see the famous peaks, pick Gardena. If the pool and the views are the point, pick Miramonti. Ortisei to Merano is about an hour by car, so many trips can have both.

guide.alt: A Miramonti room in dark timber opening onto a balcony above the valley
paras: Gardena Grödnerhof sits right in Ortisei. Take the Seceda lift and you are in the jagged high country of Val Gardena; take the gondola to the Alpe di Siusi and you are in rolling meadows. Avoid July and August if you want quiet; spring, early summer, September and October are when it shines.

Miramonti is above Merano, a spa town with a gentler climate and big views, outside the main Dolomites valleys. For hiking among the famous peaks, I would base you in Ortisei, which is exactly where Gardena is.

guide.alt: A pale-wood attic room at Miramonti with a gabled window and terrace
paras: At Gardena Grödnerhof, everything from Superior Deluxe up has been beautifully redone, and the original building was restored so well you’d never guess its age. It is my pick for the best design in the Dolomites. The Superior and Comfort rooms keep the original charm, but the renovated rooms are what I book.
At Miramonti, every room is designed differently, and the whole place is a little quirky. Because no two are alike, the right room matters, and I match one to you.

guide.alt: The indoor pool at Gardena Grödnerhof, with reclaimed wood walls and a fireplace
paras: Gardena Grödnerhof has an incredible spa, an indoor pool, an outdoor pool looking over the rooftops of Ortisei, and a gym that ties with Aman Rosa Alpina’s for the best in the Dolomites.

Miramonti’s infinity pool is the best outdoor pool of any hotel I saw in the region, and it is the reason people come. Expect German and Austrian sauna culture at both: the main saunas are mixed, and swimsuits come off.

guide.alt: A stone and oak corridor with crystal chandeliers in the Gardena Grödnerhof spa
paras: Service at Gardena Grödnerhof was warm, polished and consistent across the whole stay, and Ortisei is the best town in the region for dining off property. It works for couples and families alike, and in winter the skiing is all around you.
Miramonti is character over polish. It isn’t a top-tier luxury experience, and it is best suited to couples and design lovers who want the pool and the views.

faq.q: Which is better, Gardena Grödnerhof or Miramonti?
faq.a: For me, Gardena Grödnerhof. It was a close second to Forestis on my trip, and it is the best base in the Dolomites. Miramonti is a great stay for the right traveler: someone who wants the pool, the views and a hotel with personality.
Gardena Grödnerhof. Lifts leave from Ortisei to Seceda and to the Alpe di Siusi, two completely different landscapes. Miramonti is above Merano, outside the main Dolomites valleys.
Miramonti, for the outdoor pool; it is the best of any hotel I saw in the region. Gardena Grödnerhof has an incredible spa with indoor and outdoor pools.
Gardena Grödnerhof. It works for couples and families alike, and it made my list of the best Dolomites hotels for families. Miramonti is best suited to couples and design lovers.

faq.q: Which room should I book at each?
faq.a: At Gardena Grödnerhof, a Superior Deluxe or above; those are the renovated rooms. At Miramonti, every room is different, so I match one to you.
Yes. Ortisei to Merano is about an hour by car, and Miramonti is an easy add-on at either end of a trip built around Gardena Grödnerhof. I arrange the drivers.
